releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.4.6 (Build 83):
• Universal Google Sans Flex Typography: Integrated Google Sans Flex & Google Flex across all primary UI surfaces, sub-interfaces, and dialogs.
• Always-Fresh New Chat: Guarantees that opening Luna AI always launches a fresh, clean conversation canvas while preserving historical threads in the Chat Threads drawer.
• Ambient WebKit Collision Shield: Added multi-stop WebKit gradient masks and expanded scroll padding (+160px) to prevent message collisions under the bottom input dock.
• Mobile Single-Glance Tables: Proportional table layouts for exercises and routines without horizontal clipping or scrolling.
• Borderless OLED Action Confirmation Cards: Converted action proposals to borderless #141418 cards with responsive word wrapping and zero badge overflow.
• Gmail Avatar & Masked API Key: Synchronous profile photo in the drawer footer with live Groq API key sync and asterisk masking.
